parameters.jsCode: const crypto=require('crypto');const src=$('[029] 生成文章独立图片任务').all().filter(i=>i.json?.__empty!==true);const cfg=$('[006] 解析目标知识库').first().json;const out=[];const seen=new Set();function type(b){if(b[0]===0x89&&b[1]===0x50)return{mime:'image/png',ext:'png'};if(b[0]===0xff&&b[1]===0xd8)return{mime:'image/jpeg',ext:'jpg'};if(b.slice(0,4).toString()==='RIFF'&&b.slice(8,12).toString()==='WEBP')return{mime:'image/webp',ext:'webp'};if(b.slice(0,3).toString()==='GIF')return{mime:'image/gif',ext:'gif'};return{mime:'application/octet-stream',ext:'bin'}}function size(b,t){try{if(t.ext==='png')return{w:b.readUInt32BE(16),h:b.readUInt32BE(20)};if(t.ext==='gif')return{w:b.readUInt16LE(6),h:b.readUInt16LE(8)};if(t.ext==='webp'&&b.slice(12,16).toString()==='VP8X')return{w:1+b.readUIntLE(24,3),h:1+b.readUIntLE(27,3)}}catch{}return{w:0,h:0}}for(let i=0;i<$input.all().length;i++){let s=src[i]?.json??{};try{const m=$('[029] 生成文章独立图片任务').itemMatching(i);if(m?.json?.original_url)s=m.json}catch{}let b;try{b=await this.helpers.getBinaryDataBuffer(i,'data')}catch{continue}if(!Buffer.isBuffer(b)||b.length<Number(cfg.minImageFileSize))continue;const md5=crypto.createHash('md5').update(b).digest('hex');if(seen.has(md5))continue;seen.add(md5);const ft=type(b);if(ft.ext==='gif'||ft.ext==='bin')continue;const d=size(b,ft);if(d.w&&d.h&&(d.w<Number(cfg.minImageWidth)||d.h<Number(cfg.minImageHeight)||d.w/d.h>3.5||d.w/d.h<0.35))continue;const key=`${cfg.r2Md5Prefix}/${md5.slice(0,2)}/${md5}.${ft.ext}`;out.push({json:{...s,image_md5:md5,file_size:b.length,mime_type:ft.mime,file_extension:ft.ext,width:d.w||null,height:d.h||null,aspect_ratio:d.w&&d.h?Number((d.w/d.h).toFixed(4)):null,quality_score:d.w&&d.h?0.9:0.7,image_status:'active',r2_key:key,r2_url:String(cfg.r2PublicBaseUrl).replace(/\/+$/,'')+'/'+key},binary:$input.all()[i].binary})}return out.length?out:[{json:{__empty:true}}];
